propositions: Git 2.38+ floor must be declared and enforced rather than guarded by conditional skips, to prevent vacuous test execution where regressions silently do not run

The floor must be single-sourced in a config file (.github/git-version-floor.txt) and enforced at pytest session start via pytest_configure, failing the whole session with a diagnostic naming the required version, installed version, and capability needed

CI workflows and contributor documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, local-dev-env.md) must all declare the Git 2.38+ floor consistently, with enforcement gates in build-and-test workflows to verify the floor before test execution

The two-clone enrichment regression test (test_enrichment_drain_preserves_two_clone_union, added for bug 8185) must remain collected and executed on every gating CI environment with no skip paths available

Guards must fail loudly on module splits or renames by searching the whole tests/ tree for the merge-tree capability and skip machinery rather than pinning file paths, to avoid silent vacuity like prior incidents 34c2 and 8a5e
